_about: TOGAF 9.2 Content Metamodel used as the graph schema, with an ArchiMate 3.2 anchor kept on every entity and relationship for modeling-tool interoperability. node_types = TOGAF entities (graph nodes); edge_types = TOGAF relationships (graph edges) as directed source->target triples. `archimate_type`/`archimate_relationship` = the ArchiMate export anchor. Security is CROSS-CUTTING in TOGAF (no security domain): 05-security controls map to `requirement`/`constraint`, compliance frameworks map to `standard` (or `driver` when regulatory). `element`/`associated_with` are the generic fallbacks so no concept or link is ever lost.
framework: TOGAF 9.2 Content Metamodel (The Open Group). Official spec is behind an Open Group login; entity/relationship set reconstructed from open references (Ardoq TOGAF 9.2 metamodel, Visual Paradigm TOGAF guide) and the TOGAF 9.2 content metamodel.
security_note: Native TOGAF handling (team decision): security_control -> requirement|constraint; compliance_framework/standard -> standard (regulatory pressure -> driver). TOGAF's own `control` entity is a PROCESS control (decision logic in a process), NOT a security control.

stakeholder.name: Stakeholder
stakeholder.definition: An individual, team, or organization with interests in, or concerns relative to, the outcome of the architecture.

driver.name: Driver
driver.definition: An external or internal condition that motivates the organization to define its goals. Regulatory/compliance pressure (e.g. NCA, SAMA) lands here.

goal.name: Goal
goal.definition: A high-level statement of intent or direction for an organization.

objective.name: Objective
objective.definition: A time-bounded milestone used to demonstrate progress towards a goal.

measure.name: Measure
measure.definition: An indicator or factor, tracked over time, to determine success or alignment with objectives and goals.

requirement.name: Requirement
requirement.definition: A statement of need that must be met by the architecture. SECURITY CONTROLS map here (something the architecture must satisfy).

constraint.name: Constraint
constraint.definition: An external factor that prevents an organization from pursuing particular approaches. Restrictive security controls may map here.

assumption.name: Assumption
assumption.definition: A statement of probable fact that has not been fully validated at this stage.

principle.name: Principle
principle.definition: A qualitative statement of intent that should be met by the architecture.

gap.name: Gap
gap.definition: A statement of difference between two states (baseline and target); from 06-gap-analysis.

organization_unit.name: Organization Unit
organization_unit.definition: A self-contained unit of resources with line management responsibility, goals, objectives, and measures. The owning department.

actor.name: Actor
actor.definition: A person, organization, or system that has a role that initiates or interacts with activities. External suppliers/vendors are actors.

role.name: Role
role.definition: The usual or expected function of an actor, or the part it plays in an action or event.

business_function.name: Business Function
business_function.definition: Delivers business capabilities closely aligned to an organization, but not necessarily explicitly governed by it.

business_service.name: Business Service
business_service.definition: Supports business capabilities through an explicitly defined interface and is explicitly governed by an organization.

business_capability.name: Business Capability
business_capability.definition: A particular ability that a business may possess or exchange to achieve a specific purpose.

value_stream.name: Value Stream
value_stream.definition: An end-to-end collection of value-adding activities that create an overall result for a customer, stakeholder, or end user.

process.name: Process
process.definition: A sequence of activities that together achieve a specified outcome; can be decomposed and may consume/produce data.

event.name: Event
event.definition: An organizational state change that triggers processing.

control.name: Control
control.definition: A PROCESS control: a decision-making step with associated decision logic that determines how a process is executed. NOT a security control (those map to requirement/constraint).

product.name: Product
product.definition: Output generated by the business; the product of executing a process.

contract.name: Contract
contract.definition: An agreement between a service consumer and provider establishing functional and non-functional parameters for interaction.

service_quality.name: Service Quality
service_quality.definition: A preset configuration of non-functional attributes that may be assigned to a service or contract.

location.name: Location
location.definition: A place where business activity takes place; can be hierarchically decomposed. Data centres/sites land here (or as facility).

data_entity.name: Data Entity
data_entity.definition: An encapsulation of data recognized by a business domain expert as a thing; logical and persistent.

logical_data_component.name: Logical Data Component
logical_data_component.definition: A boundary zone that encapsulates related data entities to form a logical location for the data.

physical_data_component.name: Physical Data Component
physical_data_component.definition: A boundary zone that encapsulates related data entities to form a physical location (database/file/store) for the data.

information_system_service.name: Information System Service
information_system_service.definition: The automated elements of a business service; may deliver or support part or all of one or more business services.

logical_application_component.name: Logical Application Component
logical_application_component.definition: An encapsulation of application functionality independent of a particular implementation.

physical_application_component.name: Physical Application Component
physical_application_component.definition: An application, module, or other deployable component of functionality. The actual installed application/system.

platform_service.name: Platform Service
platform_service.definition: A technical capability required to provide enabling infrastructure that supports the delivery of applications.

logical_technology_component.name: Logical Technology Component
logical_technology_component.definition: An encapsulation of technology infrastructure independent of a particular product (a class of technology product).

physical_technology_component.name: Physical Technology Component
physical_technology_component.definition: A specific technology infrastructure product or product instance (a server/host/device).

work_package.name: Work Package
work_package.definition: A set of actions identified to achieve one or more objectives for the business.

deliverable.name: Deliverable
deliverable.definition: An architectural work product that is contractually specified and formally reviewed and signed off.

standard.name: Standard
standard.definition: A rule or guideline the architecture must adhere to. COMPLIANCE FRAMEWORKS (ISO 27001, NCA ECC, SAMA) map here.

architecture_contract.name: Architecture Contract
architecture_contract.definition: A joint agreement between development partners and sponsors on the deliverables, quality, and fitness-for-purpose of an architecture.

element.name: Generic Element (fallback)
element.definition: GENERIC FALLBACK, kept so no concept is lost. The landing type for anything that matches no TOGAF entity; flagged for review.

is_realized_through.name: is realized through
is_realized_through.definition: A goal is realized through objectives; an objective through requirements.

is_realized_by.name: is realized by
is_realized_by.definition: A more abstract element is realized by a more concrete one (incl. logical->physical).

constrains.name: constrains
constrains.definition: A constraint restricts a requirement or goal.

guides.name: guides
guides.definition: A principle guides requirements and design decisions.

has_concern.name: has concern
has_concern.definition: A stakeholder holds a concern expressed as a driver/goal/requirement.

is_resolved_by.name: is resolved by
is_resolved_by.definition: A gap is resolved by a work package.

performs.name: performs
performs.definition: An actor performs a role; a role performs a function/process.

is_owned_by.name: is owned by
is_owned_by.definition: A function/service/capability/process/application/technology/data entity is owned by an organization unit (the owning department).

is_supplied_by.name: is supplied by
is_supplied_by.definition: An application/technology component is supplied, vendored, or hosted by an external actor (the vendor/supplier).

serves.name: serves
serves.definition: An application/technology component or service serves (supports the execution of) a business process/function/service/capability.

sends_data_to.name: sends data to
sends_data_to.definition: A directional data/information flow from one component/process to another (ArchiMate Flow).

triggers.name: triggers
triggers.definition: A process/function/event triggers (initiates) another — a temporal or causal flow of control.

contributes_to.name: contributes to
contributes_to.definition: A capability/function/process contributes to (supports the achievement of) a motivation element — objective, goal, or driver.

is_decomposed_into.name: is decomposed into
is_decomposed_into.definition: Whole-part decomposition of org units, functions, or processes.

is_guided_by.name: is guided by
is_guided_by.definition: A process is guided by a (process) control.

supports.name: supports
supports.definition: A service supports a business service/capability.

governs.name: governs
governs.definition: A contract governs a service or deliverable.

accesses.name: accesses
accesses.definition: A process/application reads, writes, or read-writes a data entity.

resides_within.name: resides within
resides_within.definition: A data entity resides within a data component.

provides_consumes.name: provides or consumes
provides_consumes.definition: An application component provides or consumes an application service.

communicates_with.name: communicates with
communicates_with.definition: Directed information exchange between application components.

is_deployed_on.name: is deployed on
is_deployed_on.definition: An application component is deployed on / hosted by a technology component.

resides_at.name: resides at
resides_at.definition: A structural element resides at a location.

delivers.name: delivers
delivers.definition: A work package delivers a deliverable.

applies_to.name: applies to
applies_to.definition: A standard/compliance framework applies to the elements it governs.

associated_with.name: associated with (generic fallback)
associated_with.definition: GENERIC EDGE FALLBACK, kept so no relationship is lost. Landing type for a real link that maps to no specific edge; flagged for review.

_edge_rules: Every extracted edge must match one edge_type here and its source_types/target_types (Step 4 validation). `*` means any type. Security: a document stating a control/framework applies to a system becomes standard --applies_to--> target, or the control becomes a requirement realized/constrained by the relevant element.
